name: 1P-AL-LAD
summary: 1P-AL-LAD, also known as 1-propionyl-AL-LAD, is a derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) which has psychedelic effects and has been sold as a designer drug. It is believed to act as a prodrug for AL-LAD and produces a head-twitch response in animal studies.

pharmacology.text: It is believed to act as a prodrug for AL-LAD and produces a head-twitch response in animal studies.

uses.text: 1P-AL-LAD, also known as 1-propionyl-AL-LAD, is a derivative of lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD) which has psychedelic effects and has been sold as a designer drug.

summaryZh: 1P-AL-LAD是一種有機化合物，化學式為C25H31N3O2，為迷幻藥物麥角酸二乙醯胺的衍生物和AL-LAD（6-烯丙基-6-去甲-LSD）的前藥。
summaryZhHans: 1P-AL-LAD是一种有机化合物，化学式为C25H31N3O2，为迷幻药物麦角酸二乙酰胺的衍生物和AL-LAD（6-烯丙基-6-去甲-LSD）的前药。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: The 1P stands for propanoyl, the same three carbon group that turns LSD into 1P-LSD. Here it is attached to AL-LAD, which has an allyl group where LSD has a methyl.
fact.zh: 1P代表丙醯基，就是把LSD變成1P-LSD的那個三碳基團。在這裡它接在AL-LAD上，而AL-LAD在LSD帶甲基的位置改為烯丙基。
fact.zhHans: 1P代表丙酰基，就是把LSD变成1P-LSD的那个三碳基团。在这里它接在AL-LAD上，而AL-LAD在LSD带甲基的位置改为烯丙基。
